run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, search-index-only run. The session's network policy again blocked ALL direct HTTPS egress to tender portals and detail pages (WebFetch/DNS failed for every .gov.au and e-sourcing host), so discovery was limited to the WebSearch tool, which mostly returned stale (mid-2026) cached snapshots and third-party aggregator pages. Tier 1 government portals (Commonwealth AusTender, NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria, QLD QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, WA Tenders WA, SA, TAS, NT QTOL, ACT) were all swept via search but returned no directly-verifiable new open notices. Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel/TenderLink, universities, water/energy utilities) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne, construction head-contractors) were checked via search; all corporate channels remained login/registration-gated with no publicly-visible RFx. Only four opportunities could be captured with an identifiable buyer and plausible current status, and all are headline-level only. Primary value of this run is source discovery: eight new buyer-originated local-government sources were identified.
gaps: CRITICAL ACCESS LIMITATION (repeat of prior runs): the session's network policy blocked all direct HTTPS egress and WebFetch. DNS did not resolve for www.tenders.gov.au and every other tender host (ENOTFOUND = host outside the session's allowed network domains). No tender portal, detail page or tender document could be opened. Hosts needing allow-listing include www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au/buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au/supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, estimateone.com, and all illion TenderLink portals.

Because direct access was blocked, ALL opportunities were discovered via the WebSearch tool only. Every entry is headline-level: deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents and contacts could not be extracted and are null. Closing dates/times for aggregator-sourced items need re-verification on the live buyer portal.

The web-search index was heavily skewed to stale/cached snapshots (mostly mid-2026, e.g. Buying for Victoria and Tenders ACT snapshots from ~June-August 2026). Very few opportunities could be confirmed as open or published in the last 7 days. Live portal pages returned JavaScript-disabled shells with no listing content.

AusTender (Commonwealth): no confirmable new November-2026 ATM found via search; recent ATM examples in the index were from 2025. Federal coverage is a gap this run and is deferred to a future run with portal access.
Tenders SA: search again largely returned South African ('SA') results and stale closed SA-government items; no confirmable open South Australian government RFT. SA coverage is a gap this run.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside, Woolworths/Coles, Qantas, Telstra) mandatory check completed: no publicly-visible open RFx found; all are login/registration-gated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources (access_method=portal-registration). Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Aggregator-sourced close dates (City of Albany concrete bus shelters 25 Nov 2026 via Global Tenders; Injune Caravan Park management deed 23 Nov 2026 via Global Tenders) are lower-confidence until verified on the buyer's own portal. The Injune buyer is inferred from locality (Injune lies within Maranoa Regional Council, QLD) and is flagged as unconfirmed.

The 'Strategic climate change planning and adaptation for the Australian Marine Parks' listing (aggregator ID 626364) could not have its closing date or current status confirmed; it is recorded as recently-published/unverified because it carries a newer aggregator ID than the closed predecessor (ID 610186, closed 5 May 2026).
